name: faro
description: Faro: app de escritorio de SEO y Google Ads con agentes de IA para sitios WordPress y WooCommerce.
author: Concersa

scripts.setup: npm ci && uv sync --directory apps/engine --locked && npm run build:wp-plugin
scripts.lint: npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:rs && npm run lint:py
scripts.format: prettier --write . && cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml && uv run --directory apps/engine ruff format .
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && uv run --directory apps/engine ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && uv run --directory apps/engine mypy faro_engine tests
scripts.test: npm run test:desktop && npm run test:core && npm run test:engine && npm run test:contracts
